title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Auditorium on 1967-11-11
source: Source: 8 Track Master Reel > 1st Gen Reel (7.5ips) > PCM (Sony Beta ESXHiFi/L-750) - Given to Tim Dalton by Bob Menke; Transfer: PCM > Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > WAV 16/44.1 - Transferred By Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > Adobe Audition 1.5 > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick February 2018

ai_review.summary: Funky, psychedelic night at the Shrine with solid performance despite modest recording conditions
ai_review.review: The show is praised as an awesome, funky and psychedelic set that shouldn’t be dismissed even though the previous night may have gotten more hype. Recording-wise, Charlie Miller and friends did the best they could with limited resources, resulting in a decent but not pristine capture.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; it rates the show 4 stars and notes good energy but limited recording quality, leading to a modest overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Limited resources; decent capture but not high‑fidelity soundboard quality

show_quality.setlist_flow: Funky, psychedelic flow with an overall positive vibe throughout the set
